visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven current portable views against individually viewed Qualla west/east originals, stair finials, west living facade and lower relief detail; official 2024 room layout and aerial context. Final iteration joins the east upper wall continuously across the open bridge and corrects the wide central west glazing and projecting terrace parapet. Courtyard, pergola, gallery, garden terraces and pools remain distinct.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven current shared-material views, including map overlay and full east/back view. Stucco, cast concrete, timber and membrane use four shared metric surfaces, with separate local glass and pool water. Flat-ground fixtures expose foundation depth; actual ground contact is reviewed in independent terrain views.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen current lighting, quality and forced-detail views. Skyline keeps courtyard opening, continuous east bridge and main battered masses. District restores roof parapets, glazing, coarse pergola and terrace steps; street adds selected frieze motifs and window frames; closeup restores full repeated relief, art-glass linework and finial ribbing. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures; no physical-device performance measurement is claimed.

geographicReview.notes: Anchor [-118.29436,34.09996], heading zero: east +X, south +Z. Mapped body and courtyard hole align with room ranges and north gallery; garden terraces extend outside the roof polygon. Raw 18.7 m map height is incompatible with documented one/two-storey house and is not extruded. Unmodified USGS CA_LosAngeles_B23 ground tile is retained; datum 150.0724 m NAVD88 at north approach local [-8,-18]. Main floor Y=1.7, east upper parapet Y=8.4. Foundations descend to -2 m. Source ground under buildings is interpolated; terrain remains unflattened and footprint replacement disabled.

fidelityReview.scope: Main house, open court, upper east bridge, northern entrance gallery, attached west/east/south terraces and pools. Long northern pet pergola and separate park buildings excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Two primary and four supplemental local Qualla photographs, HABS CA-356 exterior description, official 2024 museum room layout and aerial roof context establish individual massing. Ten-degree upper-wall batter is retained. Precise room dimensions, hidden joins, garden paving and hollyhock/art-glass detail remain medium-fi interpretations rather than survey or photogrammetry. No photo pixels, vegetation, people, interiors, temporary coverings, sculpture or furniture copied.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels visually inspected and within budgets. Exact triangle and byte counts are recorded in levels; error values are authoring budgets, not measured deviations.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; independent terrain PNG encoding error recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi exterior from individually inspected Qualla photographs, HABS CA-356 description, official 2024 museum floor plan and aerial roof context. Dimensions, hidden joins and relief are interpretations, not surveyed measurements.

Main house, north entrance gallery, attached terraces and basins included. Long northern pet pergola, other park buildings, interiors, vegetation, visitors, furniture, pool sculpture, temporary construction coverings and reference-photo pixels excluded.
Independent USGS CA_LosAngeles_B23 ground preserved unmodified. Ground under buildings is source-interpolated; host terrain may differ. Preview placement retains footprint replacement disabled.
The mapped 18.7 m height is rejected as incompatible with the documented one/two-storey house. Upper east range and bridge are authored at 8.4 m above entrance-garden datum.
Hollyhock relief and art-glass patterns are simplified and progressively omitted at distant detail levels. No physical-device frame-rate measurement is claimed.
